Nicktoons.uk.desc: Ticked Off: The Loud family and Clyde arrive for a fun-filled summer at Camp Mastodon, but Lincoln and Clyde find themselves in a battle against the toughest bunk at camp.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Lincoln gets sound-canceling ear buds to drown the sound of his sisters in 'Sound of Silence', and then in 'Space Invader', Lincoln agrees to let Lynn bunk in his room, just for one night.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Lincoln is given the responsibility of taking home the class tarantula in 'Along Came a Sister', then in 'Chore and Peace', Lincoln goes on strike until someone will swap chores with him.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Lincoln signs his family up for a talent show and they form a band in 'House Music', then in 'A Novel Idea', it's Dad's Take Your Daughter to Work Day so Mom takes Lincoln to her office.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Lincoln gets a tutor that all his sisters get crushes on, making it impossible for Lincoln to study in 'Study Muffin', then in 'Homespun', a tornado threatens to destroy the house.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Lola and Lana try out for Bluebell Scouts in 'Patching Things Up', and in 'Cheater by the Dozen', when Lincoln and Clyde think Bobby is cheating on Lori they follow him gathering evidence.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: The kids worry that they have been a bad influence on Lily in 'Potty Mouth', then in 'L is for Love', a love letter shows up at the house and the family wonders who it was meant for.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: The sisters ask Lincoln to teach them how to ask their parents for money in 'Yes Man', then in 'Friend or Faux', Lisa gets her report card and must make a friend or fail at social skills.

Nicktoons.uk.title: The Loud House
Nicktoons.uk.desc: Lincoln has a plan for introducing himself to a new girl in 'White Hare', then in 'Insta-Gran', Pop Pop introduces his new girlfriend to the family.
